Order No.06/ Dated:20.04.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending their arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 72 of 2022 instituted under Sections 498A/341/323/379 of the Indian Penal Code, the petitioners have moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

As per complaint petition, the complainant was married with Jaul Ansari @ Rajaul Haque @ Md.
Rajaul Haque, petitioner in A.B.A. No. 9863 of 2022 on 09.10.2021 and on non-fulfillment of the additional demand of dowry, she was subjected to torture and abused by in-laws.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners are innocent and have committed no offence at all rather they have been falsely implicated in this case.

It is lastly submitted that the petitioners undertake to co-operate with the investigation of the case and also abide by all terms and conditions which may be imposed in the Shahruddin Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32492610/

sentences.text: Hence, the petitioners may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners.
It appears that it is a complaint case.
There is no requirement for custodial trial of the petitioners.
All the allegations are general and omnibus in nature.
Hence, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, this anticipatory bail application is disposed off.

Petitioners are directed to seek regular bail before learned trial court which shall be disposed off on its own merits in strict compliance of the guidelines laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr. reported in 2021(10) SCC 773.
